comments.author: hajile
comments.text: Jim Keller's team is creating a 6-wide issue RISC-V CPU. It should have similar IPC as ARM X1 or AMD Zen 3. [VIDEO]

comments.author: hajile
comments.why: Large RISC-V core and possible open-sourcing of CPU block.
comments.text: Jim Keller is overseeing a very large RISC-V core that should be around the same performance level as X1 or Zen 3. I guess we'll see what the ISA can do pretty soon. He said they were talking about open-sourcing the CPU block. If they did (the CPU isn't their core business), we could see lots of RISC-V competition popping up. The age of CPUs being commodity items seems to be approaching. [VIDEO]

comments.author: abdullin
comments.why: Jim Keller on Tenstorrent's Ascalon RISC-V processor.
comments.text: Jim Keller is building RISC-V Ascalon processor at Tenstorrent right now. [VIDEO] If I recall correctly, some things were planned to be open sourced.
